# `aitbc node bridge request`

Request a bridge to another island.

## Usage

```bash
aitbc node bridge request [OPTIONS]
```

## Options

| Option | Type | Default | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `--target-island-id` | text | — | yes | The Target island id. |

## Examples

```bash
aitbc node bridge request --target-island-id <target_island_id>
```
